name: Warcaller Gorlach
summary: Warcaller Gorlach patrols Orgrimmar, calling Horde champions to distant battlefronts. He rallies travelers and seasoned warriors to answer commands at outposts across Kalimdor and beyond.

sections.title: Voice of the Warchief's Call
sections.body: Warcaller Gorlach walks Orgrimmar's thoroughfares, carrying the Horde's calls for expansion and defense. He gives orders among the city's people, seeking volunteers ready to test their mettle. Some he sends to the contested canopy of Ashenvale. Others he directs toward Camp Mojache in Feralas, where scouts face the wilderness. He also calls warriors to distant campaigns in the Plaguelands. As threats rise abroad, Gorlach calls on those in the capital to take up arms.

faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach patrols Orgrimmar as an orc herald, directing Horde members toward combat zones and remote frontiers.

faq.q: Where does Warcaller Gorlach send adventurers?
faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach directs Horde champions to outposts in need, including Ashenvale, Camp Mojache in Feralas, and distant fronts such as the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Where can Warcaller Gorlach be found?
faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach patrols the streets and valleys of Orgrimmar, calling its people to arms.

angles.text: As a Horde champion looking to prove your strength or seek guidance beyond Durotar, you can turn to Gorlach for direction toward outposts in need of reinforcements.
